summary.en: Maintained by the ShyPie project. The Magpie-side gate of ShyPie's privacy-first workflow for DeepSeek Harness: with DSH on DeepSeek models behind Magpie's gateway, it turns away image/file/audio parts, encoded blobs and models outside the allowlist whenever Magpie cannot mask them locally, and fails closed on content it cannot inspect. It does not mask text (Magpie's Privacy masking does); images and files get a 403 by default unless localModels and localProviders both allow them, and the scan is bounded, so long encoded tokens can be false positives.
summary.zh: 由 ShyPie 项目维护。ShyPie 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的隐私优先工作流中 Magpie 一侧的出口门：当 DSH 通过 Magpie 网关使用 DeepSeek 模型时，对 Magpie 无法本地掩码的图片/文件/音频、编码数据块和允许列表之外的模型一律拒绝，无法检查的内容按失败关闭处理。它不做文本掩码（文本由 Magpie Privacy 负责）；图片和文件默认返回 403，除非 localModels 和 localProviders 都允许；扫描有字符预算，较长的编码串可能被误判。
